description: Color picker input. Shows a trigger button with the current color swatch and value, opening a dropdown that hosts a TmFlatColorPicker with palette, gradient, hex input, and optional alpha. Two-way binds the selected color via Value, supports keyboard interaction, an optional Apply/Cancel flow, placeholder text, and a disabled state.

parameters.name: ApplyText
parameters.description: Shows a cancel button next to Apply when is true.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Output color format. Defaults to hex.

parameters.name: OpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the dropdown open state changes.

parameters.name: PaletteColors
parameters.description: Predefined colors to display in the palette.

parameters.name: PaletteColumns
parameters.description: Number of columns in the palette grid.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text shown when no color is selected.

parameters.name: ShowApplyButton
parameters.description: When true, the dropdown shows an Apply button and only closes when the user explicitly clicks it. Changing the color inside the picker does not close the dropdown.

parameters.name: ShowCancelButton
parameters.description: Shows a cancel button next to Apply when <see cref="ShowApplyButton"/> is true.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the color value changes.
